title: 32-team table is valid
detail: 32 teams, no code used for two teams.
guards: A code mapped to two teams, which would match the wrong game.

title: Game list: each game once, final kickoff time
detail: 80 games; 0 duplicates; 0 from another season; 0 not using the provider's final start time. Kickoff moved by more than 60 min after first listing: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers (-201 min).
guards: Checkpoints measured from a stale scheduled time (most kickoffs shift a few minutes; some by hours).

title: Every game is matched or has a reason code
detail: {'matched': 65, 'no_kalshi_event': 15}
guards: Games silently dropped from the comparison.

title: Each game has its own two Kalshi markets, one per team
detail: 65 matched games; 0 Kalshi events used twice; 0 without two distinct markets; 0 markets whose ticker team is not the team they are filed under.
guards: Two games sharing one Kalshi event, or a market filed under the wrong team.

title: Ticker dates match kickoff dates (Eastern)
detail: All 65 ticker dates equal the Eastern kickoff date.
guards: Joining on UTC dates, which puts night games on the wrong day.

title: Every Kalshi team code is in the table
detail: All codes in 78 Kalshi events are known.
guards: Games left unmatched because of a code spelled differently.

title: Kalshi events not matched to a game
detail: 13 Kalshi events unmatched; 0 of them dated inside the season's game dates (listed in kalshi_events_unmatched.csv).
guards: Real games missing from the sportsbook side or mis-parsed tickers.

title: No price from after its checkpoint
detail: 2,600 prices; 0 timestamped after their checkpoint; 0 negative ages; checkpoints all 0-24 h before their kickoff.
guards: Look-ahead: using a price that did not exist yet at that moment.

title: Snapshot prices recomputed independently
detail: All 2,600 rows re-found by scanning every candle and line (no merge_asof); 0 differ.
guards: Errors in the merge_asof join (wrong key, wrong direction, unsorted input).

title: Every game x team x checkpoint x source present
detail: 2,600 rows, expected 2,600; 0 duplicates; rows without a price: DraftKings 0 of 650, FanDuel 0 of 650, Kalshi 0 of 650, Pinnacle 0 of 650
guards: Rows silently missing or doubled.

title: Kalshi prices for the two teams add up to about $1
detail: 325 game checkpoints; 0 where home mid + away mid is outside 0.85-1.15 (median sum 1.000).
guards: Two markets from different games filed as one game.

title: Kalshi and sportsbooks agree on which team is which
detail: 65 games compared at kickoff; 0 fit better with the teams swapped.
guards: A Kalshi market attached to the opposing team (prices would look wildly off).

title: Sportsbook prices are the team's own line
detail: 1,950 sportsbook prices; implied probability recomputed exactly (worst 0.0e+00); each was looked up by the team's own name.
guards: Using the opponent's price or a wrong conversion.

title: Price ages recorded
detail: 45% of sportsbook prices are more than an hour old at their checkpoint. Median ages: Kalshi 3h: 0.5 min; Pinnacle 3h: 64.4 min; Kalshi 1h: 0.5 min; Pinnacle 1h: 8.2 min; Kalshi 15m: 0.5 min; Pinnacle 15m: 52.2 min. Costs only use prices within the maximum age (costs.MAX_AGE_MIN); older ones are marked not usable, so checkpoints with few fresh snapshots have few costs.
guards: Comparing a Kalshi price from one minute ago with a sportsbook price from this morning.

title: Every game x team x checkpoint x venue x ruler (x n) once
detail: 20800 rows, expected 20800 (65 games x 2 teams x 5 checkpoints x 4 rulers x (5 Kalshi sizes + 3 books)); 0 duplicates.
guards: A combination dropped or counted twice.

title: Each ruler's two fair chances add up to 100%
detail: Largest gap 2.22e-16 over 1300 game-checkpoint-rulers.
guards: Margin not fully removed, or the two teams swapped between rulers.

title: Cost per $10 recomputed independently from the snapshots
detail: 13186 usable rows recomputed with exact fractions, a closed-form Shin and the fee rounded up to the cent; 0 differ.
guards: Wrong fee, wrong de-vig, wrong team's price, or the price/fair the wrong way round.

title: Each sportsbook costs more than its own fair price
detail: 0 of 1104 own-ruler sportsbook rows are negative.
guards: De-vig adding margin instead of removing it.

title: Kalshi fee per order is the exact fee rounded up by less than 1 cent
detail: 0 Kalshi rows outside [exact fee, exact fee + 1 cent).
guards: Fee rounded down, charged per contract instead of per order, or left out.

title: n applies to Kalshi only
detail: 0 sportsbook rows with an n, 0 Kalshi rows without one.
guards: Sportsbook rows repeated per order size, inflating counts.

title: No sportsbook price older than the maximum age is used
detail: 0 usable rows break it. Usable: 13186 of 20800; max ages (min): 24h 360, 3h 45, 1h 15, 15m 10, close 60.
guards: A morning sportsbook price compared with a Kalshi price from a minute before kickoff.

title: n values are real trade sizes
detail: Using the team's placeholder sizes 1, 5, 10, 25, 100: run make trade-sizes for this season, then re-run.
guards: Costs for order sizes nobody trades.
